    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "0% Accuracy, 100% Luck",
      "goal": "Survive the Isekai tutorial by exploiting a glitch in the 'Luck' stat that guarantees critical hits on missed attacks.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From a confused casualty to a high-variance glass cannon with a target on his back.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Protagonist dies in a mundane accident and wakes up in the System's arrival lounge.",
        "to_next": "The protagonist realizes his 'broken' build requires specific gear to be viable outside the tutorial zone."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Welcome to the Lobby",
          "intent": "Introduce the protagonist's death and the absurdity of the System's arrival lounge.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist reaches the tutorial kiosk and receives his initial stat allocation.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie wakes up in a void of white light, confused about his death and the floating text in front of him.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie accepts his death and begins moving toward the only visible structure.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "introduces": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Arrival Void",
              "location_end_label": "Arrival Void",
              "location_start": "A dimensionless expanse of shimmering white light.",
              "location_end": "The edge of a floating platform made of liquid code.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie opens his eyes to a ceiling made of shifting hexagonal tiles.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["shifting hexagonal tiles", "white floor light", "distant electronic hum"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie steps onto the liquid code platform, his boots creating ripples in the data.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["liquid code platform", "blue data ripples", "floating text boxes"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie navigates the arrival lounge, observing other confused souls and the bizarre 'amenities' provided by the System.",
              "type": "exploration",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies the tutorial kiosk as his next destination.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "location_start_label": "Arrival Lounge",
              "location_end_label": "Arrival Lounge",
              "location_start": "A surreal waiting room with velvet chairs and floating beverage trays.",
              "location_end": "The queue leading to a glowing obsidian kiosk.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie pushes through the velvet chairs of the arrival lounge.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["velvet chairs", "floating beverage trays", "humming neon signs"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie joins the line of souls waiting before the glowing obsidian kiosk.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["obsidian kiosk", "glowing blue interface", "translucent queue barriers"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie interacts with the kiosk, where a glitch in the stat-rolling process grants him a Luck stat of 999 while tanking his Accuracy to 0.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie receives his 'broken' stat allocation and is teleported to the tutorial range.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "introduces": ["CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Kiosk",
              "location_end_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_start": "A high-tech terminal pulsing with administrative power.",
              "location_end": "An open-air field filled with straw dummies and wooden targets.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie places his hand on the obsidian kiosk's cold surface.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["cold obsidian surface", "pulsing terminal lights", "scrolling stat numbers"],
              "transition_out_text": "A flash of white light pulls Artie from the kiosk and drops him onto the grass of the practice range.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["crushed green grass", "straw dummy scent", "wooden target silhouettes"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist reaches the tutorial kiosk and receives his initial stat allocation."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Glitch in the Machine",
          "intent": "Establish the 'Luck' stat exploit through experimentation on tutorial dummies.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie attempts to hit a practice dummy with a basic sword but misses every single swing due to his 0 Accuracy.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he cannot hit anything through normal means.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_LUCK_EXPLOIT"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "location_start_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_end_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_start": "The center of the tutorial field.",
              "location_end": "Standing before a heavily dented but unhit straw dummy.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie grips the hilt of the tutorial sword, the leather wrap feeling rough in his palm.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rough leather hilt", "straw dummy torso", "whistling sword swings"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie pants heavily, staring at the dummy that remains completely unscathed despite his efforts.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["unscathed straw", "heavy breathing", "dust motes in sunlight"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Frustrated, Artie throws his sword at a dummy; the System registers a 'Miss', but his Luck triggers a critical hit on the 'missed' calculation.",
              "type": "discovery",
              "outcome": "The dummy explodes in a shower of straw and damage numbers.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "location_start_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_end_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_start": "The practice range, ten paces from the dummy.",
              "location_end": "The scorched patch of earth where the dummy once stood.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie hurls the sword with a desperate shout, watching it spin wildly off-course.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["spinning iron blade", "desperate shout", "glitching red text"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie shields his eyes as the dummy detonates into a cloud of golden straw.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["golden straw cloud", "floating damage numbers", "scorched earth smell"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie spends time refining the 'Miss-Crit' technique, learning that the more he misses, the harder the system over-corrects with Luck.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie masters the timing of his intentional misses.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "location_start_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_end_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_start": "A row of practice dummies.",
              "location_end": "The edge of the practice range, littered with destroyed targets.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie picks up a fresh training sword and eyes the next row of dummies.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["fresh training sword", "row of dummies", "setting tutorial sun"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie wipes sweat from his brow, surrounded by the wreckage of the entire training field.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["wrecked wooden stands", "torn straw bundles", "dull sword edge"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "A final test dummy appears, moving at high speed; Artie closes his eyes and swings wildly, triggering a massive 'Miss-Crit'.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The high-speed dummy is vaporized, completing the training segment.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "location_start_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_end_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_start": "The center of the range.",
              "location_end": "The gateway leading to the boss arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A mechanical dummy clicks into motion, zipping across the grass on a hidden track.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["clicking mechanical dummy", "hidden metal track", "closed eyelids"],
              "transition_out_text": "The dummy vanishes in a pixelated explosion, and the gate to the boss arena creaks open.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["pixelated explosion", "creaking iron gate", "stone archway shadow"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Tutorial Boss Logic",
          "intent": "Demonstrate the build's viability in a low-stakes boss encounter.",
          "end_condition": "The tutorial boss is defeated via the 'Miss-Crit' exploit, granting passage to the world.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie enters the boss arena and faces the 'Guardian of the Threshold', a massive stone golem.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The boss battle begins, and Artie realizes he needs to dodge to survive.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "A circular stone amphitheater.",
              "location_end": "The center of the arena, facing the golem.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps onto the cracked marble of the boss arena.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["cracked marble floor", "massive stone golem", "heavy thudding footsteps"],
              "transition_out_text": "The golem raises a fist the size of a boulder, and Artie prepares to dive.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["boulder-sized fist", "grinding stone joints", "shadow of the golem"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Artie kites the golem, intentionally missing his counter-attacks to build up 'Luck-Crit' stacks.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The golem's health bar begins to chunk down as Artie's 'misses' connect with reality-warping force.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "The dusty floor of the arena.",
              "location_end": "The golem's crumbling feet.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie rolls beneath the golem's swing, the wind of the impact ruffling his hair.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["impact wind", "dusty arena floor", "glowing blue weakpoints"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie swings his sword at the air behind the golem, triggering a shockwave that cracks the golem's torso.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["air-shattering shockwave", "cracked stone torso", "golem's roar of pain"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Artie delivers the final 'Miss-Crit', shattering the golem and receiving his first loot drop: a bag of gold and a tutorial exit pass.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The golem is defeated, and Artie exits the tutorial zone into the main world.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:9",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "The Outskirts",
              "location_start": "The center of the shattered arena.",
              "location_end": "A grassy hill overlooking a bustling fantasy city.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie throws a punch at a butterfly, and the resulting 'Miss-Crit' sends the golem's head flying.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["flying stone head", "shattered golem core", "tutorial completion chime"],
              "transition_out_text": "The world fades into a portal of white light, and Artie finds himself standing on a grassy hill.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["grassy hill slope", "distant city spires", "tutorial exit pass"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss is defeated via the 'Miss-Crit' exploit, granting passage to the world."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {

      "title": "The Math of Murder",
      "goal": "Acquire the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' to enable the 'Hit & Run' portion of the build.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",

        "from_prev": "Exiting the tutorial with a mountain of 'Missed' critical damage data.",

        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "slow_burn",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },

          "scenes": [

              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie enters the city of Oakhaven and realizes he is incredibly slow compared to other players.",

              "outcome": "Artie decides he needs to prioritize Agility and movement speed.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:10",
              "location_start_label": "City Gates",
              "location_end_label": "Main Square",

              "location_end": "The bustling center of the city square.",

              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie walks through the iron-bound gates, his footsteps echoing on the cobblestones.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["iron-bound gates", "echoing cobblestones", "city guard spears"],

              "transition_in_text": "Artie sits on the edge of the fountain and opens his character sheet.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["fountain edge", "translucent character sheet", "glowing stat numbers"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie stands and heads toward the row of equipment shops, his eyes scanning the signs.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["equipment shop signs", "iron armor clanking", "leather smell"],

              "transition_out_text": "Artie stares at the yellowed tag on the boots, his heart racing at the speed bonus listed.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["yellowed price tag", "speed bonus text", "worn leather boots"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist identifies the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' in a local shop's inventory."

        },
        {

          "end_condition": "Protagonist purchases the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' from a sketchy vendor.",
          "scenes": [

              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",

              "transition_in_text": "Artie walks into the tall grass of the Oakhaven fields, his sword drawn.",

              "outcome": "Artie accumulates a large amount of low-level loot and gold.",

              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Fields",

              "location_start": "The center of the rat-infested field.",

              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie runs in a wide circle, drawing the attention of every rat in the vicinity.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rat squeaks", "churned field dirt", "looming swarm of pests"],

              "transition_out_anchors": ["sea of loot bags", "ticking gold counter", "blood-stained grass"],

              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie returns to the shop and meets Silas the Shifty, who tries to overcharge him for the boots.",

              "outcome": "Artie uses his high Luck to 'critically succeed' a social check, lowering the price.",

              "summary": "Artie equips the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' and feels an immediate surge of speed.",

          "intent": "Test the new movement speed in conjunction with the luck exploit.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist successfully kites a pack of field mobs without taking a hit.",
          "scenes": [

              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie heads to a more dangerous area of the fields to test his speed against 'Swift-Wolves'.",

              "outcome": "Artie finds that he can now outrun the wolves, but the timing for his 'Miss-Crit' is harder.",

              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "location_start_label": "Highlands Field",
